about.title: About Me
about.intro: I'm Zübeyir Ali Demir, a Software Developer.
about.lead: Before Computer Engineering, I spent a couple of years in medical school — I suppose I've always been someone who gets caught up in details, I just changed the field. I graduated in Computer Engineering from Istanbul University-Cerrahpaşa and work as a freelance developer.
about.body: I built real-time data pipelines at Baykar, saw banking infrastructure up close at Vakıfbank, and ERP systems from the inside at Uyumsoft. I work across a wide range — from React to SwiftUI, LightGBM to .NET — but what interests me most is how the decisions behind an interface end up feeling to the person using it.

highlights: Integrated Server-Sent Events (SSE) for real-time data flow in React and TypeScript-based web applications.
Improved mobile usability, responsive behavior and app-like experience through PWA-focused frontend work.
Integrated auto-generated TypeScript API client structures for type-safe API communication and frontend-backend consistency.
Made server-state, cache management and async API flows more consistent with React Query.
Studied transaction flows, service communication and production infrastructure processes in Internet Banking and end-to-end encrypted POS systems.
Observed monitoring, maintenance and troubleshooting processes for critical digital services in a corporate banking environment.
Supported infrastructure analysis and issue-resolution work to understand system reliability and service continuity.
Learned secure, scalable and highly available infrastructure practices used in FinTech systems.
Worked on business workflows, modular structure and enterprise application logic in ERP-focused software development.
Completed BusTicketWebRazor, a .NET Razor application with database operations, as my internship's final project.
Managed financial planning and budgeting for club events, workshops and student initiatives.
Worked with the board on event feasibility, budget optimization and funding prioritization.

Took part in founding Parker's Family, an education initiative launched by 7 co-founders — contributed to location selection, leasing a five-story education building, and building the operational infrastructure.
Took active responsibility in planning education operations, building the academic calendar, organizing mock exams and managing student processes.
Worked with the founding team on organizational decision-making, team coordination and running day-to-day operations.

projects.title: Featured Projects
projects.description: Projects I've built across different scales — from academic thesis work to enterprise production, mobile apps to 3D web experiences.

items.title: 360° Performance Evaluation System
items.summary: A performance prediction and personalized development planning system powered by LightGBM and XGBoost.
items.description: Developed as an undergraduate thesis, this project evaluates employee performance from multiple perspectives (360°) and predicts future performance using machine learning models. It combines manager, peer, and self-assessment data to generate individualized development plans. Model training and comparison were conducted using the Python ecosystem.
highlights: Performance prediction with LightGBM and XGBoost models
Data preprocessing and feature engineering with Pandas and NumPy
360° evaluation metrics: manager, peer, self-assessment
Personalized development plan generation
Model comparison and hyperparameter optimization

items.title: Best Friend App
items.summary: An AI-powered mobile app providing outfit suggestions and emotional support.
items.description: An AI-powered mobile application consisting of two main modules. The Kombin AI module analyzes the user's wardrobe and suggests outfit combinations based on weather, event type, and personal style. The Yakın Dostum module provides emotional support and daily motivation through natural language processing. The iOS interface was built with SwiftUI, the backend with .NET, and AI services with Python.
highlights: Native iOS user interface development with SwiftUI
.NET backend API design and implementation
Python-based AI service integration
RESTful API architecture for cross-platform communication
Outfit recommendation algorithm and NLP module

items.title: Enterprise Real-Time Web Solution
items.summary: An enterprise web application delivering real-time data streams via Server-Sent Events.
items.description: A frontend application developed to manage live data streams in an enterprise environment. Server-Sent Events (SSE) protocol enables one-way real-time data transmission from server to client. React Query handles server state management, combined with a component-based architecture and TypeScript for type safety.
highlights: Real-time data streaming with Server-Sent Events (SSE)
Server state management and caching with React Query
Type-safe component architecture with TypeScript
Enterprise-scale performance optimization
Responsive and accessible interface design

items.title: Personal 3D Web Portfolio
items.summary: This site brings together a personal Blockbench character, pointer-tracking eyes and a bilingual content system.
items.description: An interactive portfolio site developed to best represent personal brand identity in the digital space. A custom 3D character modeled in Blockbench was brought to the browser via React Three Fiber with pointer-tracking eye animation. A bilingual English-Turkish content system was built with Next.js App Router and next-intl.
highlights: Custom 3D character modeling with Blockbench
In-browser 3D scene management with React Three Fiber
Pointer-tracking eye animation and interactive character
English / Turkish bilingual content system with next-intl
Modern page structure and SEO with Next.js App Router

items.title: Airline Website
items.summary: A comprehensive web automation project covering airline ticket sales, flight management and customer operations.
items.description: A comprehensive web automation project digitizing airline operations. It includes flight search, ticket purchasing, reservation management, and customer profile operations. A modern and responsive user interface was built with React and TypeScript, while Node.js powered the backend API services.
highlights: Flight search, filtering, and ticket purchase flows
Component-based and reusable UI with React
Type-safe development process with TypeScript
RESTful API integration with Node.js backend
Mobile-compatible responsive design

items.title: BusTicketWebRazor
items.summary: A .NET Razor-based web application for bus ticket sales and route management.
items.description: Built with .NET Razor Pages architecture, this web application brings bus company operations — route planning, ticket sales, and passenger management — into the digital space. Full CRUD (create, read, update, delete) operations are supported with SQL database integration. Server-side rendering ensures fast page load times.
highlights: Server-side web application with .NET Razor Pages
SQL database design and full CRUD operations
Route planning and ticket sales management panel
Business logic layer and data validation with C#
Passenger registration and ticket inquiry systems
